title: AMARIS: Merging Generalist and Specialist LLMs via Adaptive Subspace Inheritance
abstract: arXiv:2611.27369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Domain specialization of large language models (LLMs) often improves target-domain performance but degrades broad capabilities. Model merging is an attractive training-free alternative, yet common parameter-space strategies (for example, interpolation and sparsified averaging) provide limited control over task-specific interference. We introduce Adaptive Model Alignment via Ranked Inherited Subspaces (AMARIS), a covariance-driven framework that transfers specialist updates only along selected activation directions. AMARIS formulates merging as budgeted subspace inheritance: it seeks high specialist activation capture under a regularized base-output perturbation budget, then builds a low-rank projection gate from ranked generalized eigendirections. This yields a single static merged checkpoint that concentrates transfer in high-utility, low-interference directions. We evaluate AMARIS on Qwen3-based merges (8B and 32B) across finance, inst

translated_title: AMARIS：通过自适应子空间继承融合通用与专家大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的领域专业化通常能提升目标领域的性能，但会损害其广泛能力。模型合并是一种无需训练的有吸引力的替代方案，然而常见的参数空间策略（例如插值和稀疏化平均）对任务特定干扰的控制能力有限。我们提出了通过排序继承子空间实现自适应模型对齐（AMARIS），这是一个由协方差驱动的框架，仅沿选定的激活方向传递专家模型的更新。AMARIS 将合并表述为预算化的子空间继承：在正则化的基础输出扰动预算下，寻求对专家激活的最大捕获，然后从排序后的广义特征方向构建低秩投影门控。由此得到一个单一的静态合并检查点，将知识迁移集中在高效用、低干扰的方向上。我们在基于 Qwen3 的合并模型（8B 和 32B）上评估了 AMARIS，涵盖金融、保险等领域（原文摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: AMARIS 提出了一种协方差驱动的免训练模型合并框架，通过在正则化扰动预算下选择高效用、低干扰的激活子空间，将专家模型能力以单一静态检查点的形式无训练地继承到通用大语言模型中。
en_tdlr: AMARIS is a covariance-driven, training-free model merging framework that inherits specialist capabilities into generalist LLMs by selecting high-utility, low-interference activation subspaces under a regularized perturbation budget, producing a single static merged checkpoint.
